match_evaluation.description: A short explanation of how well the CV matches what is asked in the JD.

items.description: List of requirements for the job position described in the JD.
Requirements in the JD that are indicated to be necessary, if any; otherwise null. Account for semantic meaning instead of relying on explicit words such as `mandatory`.
Requirements in the JD that are indicated to be optional, if any; otherwise null. Account for semantic meaning instead of relying on explicit words such as `optional`.
Requirements in the JD that are supported by the CV, if any; otherwise null.
Requirements in the JD that are not supported by the CV, if any; otherwise null.
